objective: Estimate the prespecified treatment-group difference in overall survival from treatment initiation.

questions.text: What is the adjusted association between treatment group and overall survival?

inputs.description: One record per participant with treatment, entry, event, censoring, and covariate fields.

outcomes.definition: Time from treatment initiation to death from any cause, censored at last known follow-up.

analysis_sets.definition: Eligible participants with a valid time origin and determinable event or censoring time.

contrasts.definition: New treatment compared with standard treatment.

approvals: IRB approval or exemption must cover the secondary analysis.
restrictions: Analyze coded participant data only in the approved environment.

steps.purpose: Apply eligibility, time-origin, delayed-entry, event, and censoring definitions.
steps.method: Prespecified cohort-construction rules with an auditable exclusion ledger.

steps.purpose: Estimate the adjusted treatment association and absolute survival summaries.
steps.method: Cox proportional-hazards model plus adjusted survival estimates and diagnostics.

required_outputs.description: Effect estimate, interval, event count, denominator, and adjusted survival summaries.
Censoring, proportional-hazards, influence, and sensitivity diagnostics.

validation.criterion: Every analyzed participant has a nonnegative follow-up time and a valid event indicator.

clinical_time_to_event.target_population: Adults with the prespecified cancer receiving first-line standard or new treatment.
clinical_time_to_event.censoring_definition: Alive at the last documented clinical contact.
clinical_time_to_event.estimand: Adjusted hazard ratio and 12-month survival probability difference in the eligible cohort.
